name: Singular
shortInfo: Aggregate stats about your marketing campaigns
about:
Zero time chasing data. More time driving growth. Get a complete view of ROI with next-gen attribution, full-funnel marketing data, and best-in-class fraud prevention.  
  
Learn more about [Singular API documentation.](https://www.singular.net/)
availableData:
[Combined Creative Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/singular/pipelines/combined-creative-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve a combination of both network (such as cost) and tracker stats (such as installs and revenue) at Creative-level breakdown.

[Combined Keyword Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/singular/pipelines/combined-keyword-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve a combination of both network (such as cost) and tracker stats (such as installs and revenue) at Keyword-level breakdown.

[Combined Placement Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/singular/pipelines/combined-placement-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve a combination of both network (such as cost) and tracker stats (such as installs and revenue) at Placement-level breakdown.

[Combined Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/singular/pipelines/combined-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve a combination of both network (such as cost) and tracker stats (such as installs and revenue).

[Custom Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/singular/pipelines/custom-report.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve data based on a wide variety of dimensions and metrics as per user requirement.

[Network Creative Breakdown](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/singular/pipelines/network-creative-breakdown.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve campaign statistics ingested from all the ad networks you have set up in Singular at Creative-level breakdown.

Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/singular/index.html) here.
